description: Named signal correlation patterns. When multiple signal types appear within time_window_days, the pattern matches and produces a priority_boost and narrative.

patterns.name: Post-Funding Expansion
patterns.description: Company raised capital and is actively expanding headcount — classic tool evaluation window
patterns.narrative_template: {company} recently closed {funding_type} and immediately began expanding headcount. This combination signals a 90-day window during which infrastructure and tooling decisions are actively being made.

patterns.name: Leadership-Driven Tool Evaluation
patterns.description: New executive hire triggers tooling evaluation in their first 90 days
patterns.narrative_template: A new {executive_role} has joined {company}. New executives typically evaluate and reshape the technology stack in their first 60-90 days. The concurrent hiring spike confirms a scaling phase is underway.

patterns.name: Technology Migration Cycle
patterns.description: Evidence of active technology change combined with engineering hiring
patterns.narrative_template: {company} is actively migrating or adopting new technology while expanding their engineering team, indicating an active vendor evaluation phase.

patterns.name: Product Launch Infrastructure Build
patterns.description: Product launch often precedes infrastructure investment
patterns.narrative_template: {company} launched {product_name} and is simultaneously scaling their engineering team, indicating a platform build-out is underway.

patterns.name: Post-Funding Leadership Restructure
patterns.description: Funding followed by leadership change — new executive spending new capital
patterns.narrative_template: {company} closed {funding_type} and subsequently brought in a new {executive_role}. This combination — new capital plus new leadership — creates a high-conviction window for vendor evaluation before the new executive sets the technology agenda.

patterns.name: Triple Signal — High Conviction Buy
patterns.description: Three or more independent buying signals in a 30-day window
patterns.narrative_template: {company} has generated {signal_count} independent buying signals in the past {days} days. The convergence of {signal_types} from multiple sources indicates a genuine and active buying cycle.
